name: When should I call a professional for black mold removal?

mainEntity.name: When should I call a professional for black mold removal?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should contact a professional for black mold removal if the affected area is larger than roughly 10 square feet (about 3 feet by 3 feet), if the mold growth is due to contaminated water (e.g., sewage backup), or if you experience persistent health symptoms that you suspect are mold-related. Professionals have the necessary equipment and expertise to safely contain and remove mold, prevent its spread, and address underlying moisture issues effectively, particularly in hard-to-reach areas.
acceptedAnswer.description: Call a professional for black mold removal if the affected area is large (over 10 sq ft), if water was contaminated, or if you have mold-related health concerns.
